hypothesis: The selected 12-channel RGB realtime student improves spatial edges but regresses temporal-delta PSNR. A 14-channel student initialized to reproduce it exactly, trained on deterministic adjacent UI motion with an explicit temporal loss, can recover temporal consistency while the measured fused 14-channel kernel remains within the M5 60 FPS compute budget.

candidate.initialization: exact 12-channel function plus isolated trainable two-channel side branch

data.pair_generation: same-source translated adjacent UI crops with shared scale and deterministic quantization

early_gate.step_250: Ground-truth, edge, and teacher PSNR may not regress more than 0.02 dB; temporal-delta PSNR must gain more than 0.02 dB; static-delta MAE must decrease.
early_gate.step_500: All three spatial metrics must be nonnegative versus the exact parent-equivalent start and both temporal metrics must improve.

runtime_gate: After quality gates pass, benchmark the exact learned weights at full 1920x1080 to 3840x2160 in the fused browser shader; require p95 below 16.67 ms before replacing the 12-channel live profile.
